name: onedrive
description: Secure OneDrive access through the registered CloudStorage Portal connection.

interface.longDescription: Package the registered OneDrive connection and its bounded OneDrive skill. OneDrive owns the Microsoft connection flow. CloudStorage Portal consumes it alongside Dropbox and Google Drive, while CloudStorage Portal Local owns the separate local MCP runtime.
interface.defaultPrompt: Vis min verificerede OneDrive-konto og indholdet i roden uden at ændre filer.
